chunks.text: Tea and coffee are two of the most popular drinks in the world, however,
people usually prefer one more than the other.
Sometimes people argue about which is better.
Tea drinking started in China over 4,000 years ago.
These days, some people drink tea for health or losing weight.
However, most people think of tea as more than just a healthy drink.
In fact, tea drinking has become a kind of culture.
Tourists are often happy to be part of the local tea culture.
You might imagine that in the past, people gathered in a noble person's house at 3 o'clock p.m.
The hostess greets each guest and begins to pour tea into their cups.
In Turkey, tea is always there when people meet, whether offered in someone's home, a company or at a restaurant.
In the UK, homes and offices usually have afternoon tea time when tea and other snacks are served.
People may use a spoon to mix milk and tea together and enjoy it with biscuits.
It is a way of relaxing with friends or co-workers.
Coffee came just over 1,000 years ago.
Coffee is made from beans.
Something in the coffee beans makes a person feel active.
Many people drink coffee in the morning to help them wake up before going to their jobs.
Others also drink coffee in the afternoon to keep going through the working day.
Some people may visit coffee shops just to meet and talk with friends.
However, many people in coffee shops drink coffee while working on their computers or reading some articles.
